curriculum.title: Project 1: Security Lab Setup
curriculum.description: Create a security assessment, lab report, or hardened system checklist for Ethical Hacking that demonstrates authorized testing, risk documentation, secure configuration, evidence quality, and remediation planning.

tasks.title: Define Project Brief
tasks.assignment: Write the objective, target user or stakeholder, success criteria, assumptions, and constraints for the Security Lab Setup in the context of Ethical Hacking.
tasks.submission: A concise brief document with objective, scope, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks whether the brief is specific, realistic, scoped, and aligned with the course topic.

tasks.title: Plan Workflow and Resources

tasks.title: Build Core Output

tasks.ai_review: The AI checks completeness, practical correctness, structure, and alignment with the stated brief.
